scripts.format:check: npm run prettier:check && npm run tslint:check && npm run eslint:check
scripts.format:fix: npm run prettier:fix && npm run tslint:fix && npm run eslint:fix
scripts.tslint:check: find src/ -regextype egrep -regex '^.*\.ts$' |xargs npx tslint -c google.tslint.json
scripts.tslint:fix: find src/ -regextype egrep -regex '^.*\.ts$' |xargs npx tslint -c google.tslint.json --fix
scripts.build:trace_processor: PERFETTO_TOP=../../../external/perfetto; (cd $PERFETTO_TOP && tools/install-build-deps --ui && ui/node ui/build.js --out trace_processor_build) && rm -rf deps_build/trace_processor && mkdir -p deps_build/trace_processor && rsync -ar $PERFETTO_TOP/trace_processor_build/ deps_build/trace_processor && mkdir deps_build/trace_processor/to_be_served && cp deps_build/trace_processor/ui/dist_version/engine_bundle.js deps_build/trace_processor/to_be_served/ && cp deps_build/trace_processor/wasm_memory64/trace_processor_memory64.wasm deps_build/trace_processor/to_be_served/ && cp deps_build/trace_processor/wasm/trace_processor.wasm deps_build/trace_processor/to_be_served/ && (cd $PERFETTO_TOP && rm -rf trace_processor_build)
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:trace_processor && npm run build:protos && npm run build:app
scripts.install:chromedriver: chrome_version=$(google-chrome --version |cut -d' ' -f3); rm -rf deps_build/chromedriver-linux64 && mkdir -p deps_build/chromedriver-linux64 && (cd deps_build/chromedriver-linux64 && wget https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/${chrome_version}/linux64/chromedriver-linux64.zip && cd .. && unzip chromedriver-linux64/chromedriver-linux64.zip)
scripts.test:presubmit: npm run build:protos && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit:ci && npm run deps_graph:check_cycles
scripts.test:all: npm run format:check && npm run test:unit:ci && npm run test:e2e && npm run deps_graph:check_cycles
